description: Write a reply to a post on X for the user. Nothing posts: chat shows the original post above the reply, with Copy and Reply on X, which opens X's composer as a reply with the text filled in. Use this whenever the user asks you to reply to, answer or respond to an X post, and call it again with the revised text when they want changes. Write in the user's voice, 280 characters at most, no hashtags.

url.description: The post being replied to: its x.com or twitter.com link.
